fields.disappearance: Pauṣa Kṛṣṇa Tṛtīyā (the Gauḍīya calendar: Māgha Kṛṣṇa Tṛtīyā, the same day counted from the full moon), in Vṛndāvana
fields.place: Born at Śrīkhaṇḍa; lived at Kumāranagara and at Teliyā-Budhuri (Murshidabad); left his body in Vṛndāvana
fields.works: Songs on Gaurāṅga; Smaraṇa-camatkāra, Smaraṇa-darpaṇa, Siddhānta-candrikā and a life of Śrīnivāsa Ācārya (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna)
fields.notes:
Vaidya; son of Cirañjīva Sena and Sunandā, daughter of the Śākta poet Dāmodara Kavirāja; elder brother of Govinda dāsa Kavirāja; wife Ratnamālā. Dearest disciple of Śrīnivāsa Ācārya, whom he met as a bridegroom passing Jājigrāma (Bhakti-ratnākara 8.530); Narottama's inseparable friend. Title Kavirāja from Jīva Gosvāmī and the Vaiṣṇavas of Vṛndāvana (Bhakti-ratnākara 9.214); first of the eight Kavirājas. With Gaṅgānārāyaṇa Cakravartī defeated the smārtas of Rājā Narasiṁha at Kumārapura. Śikṣā-guru of Vīra Hāmvīra (Abhidhāna). Died in Vṛndāvana in separation from the Gosvāmīs.

Siddha name: Karuṇā-mañjarī.

Not the Rāmacandra Kavirāja of Nityānanda's branch (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 11.51), whom the Gauḍīya Maṭha edition identifies with him.

fields.name: Vīra Hāmvīra
fields.notes: King of Vana-viṣṇupura; a robber-king who had the Gosvāmīs' books stolen and was converted by Śrīnivāsa Ācārya, who gave him dīkṣā; Jīva Gosvāmī named him Caitanya dāsa (Bhakti-ratnākara 7.61, 9.5, 9.265-273). Wife: Sulakṣaṇā. Son: Dhāḍī (Dhīra) Hāmvīra. Installed Śrī Kālācāṅd. Arranged Śrīnivāsa's marriage to Gaurāṅgapriyā. Two songs by him (Karṇānanda p. 19). Śikṣā-guru: Rāmacandra Kavirāja (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna).

fields.name: Dhāḍī Hāmvīra
fields.aka: Dhīra Hāmvīra, Dhadi Hamvira, Gopāla dāsa
fields.notes: Son of King Vīra Hāmvīra of Viṣṇupura. Took dīkṣā from Śrīnivāsa Ācārya with his father and was named Gopāla dāsa; some say Jīva Gosvāmī called him Caitanya dāsa (Karṇānanda 1). (See also «Gopāla dāsa Bahādura».)

First wife and disciple of Śrīnivāsa Ācārya. Daughter of Gopāla Cakravartī, a zamindar of Jājigrāma (Bardhamān); her brothers Śyāmadāsa and Rāmacandra were also Śrīnivāsa's disciples. Before her marriage she was Draupadī; she was named Īśvarī after dīkṣā (Bhakti-ratnākara 8.495). Married on the Akṣaya-tṛtīyā of Vaiśākha, the marriage arranged by Raghunandana Ṭhākura. Her children: Vṛndāvana-vallabha, Rādhākṛṣṇa, Hemalatā, Kṛṣṇapriyā, Kāñcanalatikā (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna). Named in the Karṇānanda and Prema-vilāsa.

fields.name: Gaurāṅgapriyā
fields.notes: Second wife and disciple of Śrīnivāsa Ācārya; daughter of Rāghava (Raghu) Cakravartī of Gopālapura, who dreamt that he gave her to Śrīnivāsa. King Vīra Hāmvīra arranged the wedding; Jāhnavā Mātā, arriving at Jājigrāma from Vṛndāvana, took the bride on her lap. Her son: Gatigovinda (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna). Her earlier name was Padmāvatī.

fields.disappearance: Pauṣa Kṛṣṇa Trayodaśī (Gauḍīya calendar, month counted from the full moon; the Abhidhāna's «Agrahāyaṇa Kṛṣṇa Trayodaśī» is the same day counted from the new moon), 1463 Śaka (1541 CE), at the age of 60
